item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json, copy, work\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json'))\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json'))\\n# Current report inputs\\nprint(json.dumps([work.evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]))\\n# Boundary, precedence, and immutability checks\\ncases=[\\n ({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'edges':{},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':99}, {'edges':{'a>b':{'role':'right'}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':False}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':1}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n ({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True,'attempts':-1}, {'edges':{'a>b':{}},'retry_limit':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),\\n]\\nfor req, pol, expected in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=work.evaluate(req,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert (req,pol)==before\\nprint('checks passed')\"]}"}
